title: Immunization Protocol, Immunization Services: Earlier Live Zoster Vaccine Records on Recombinant Zoster Courses
content:
## Clause Z — Records dated before the recombinant vaccine (Immunization Services)

Z.1 Where the number of a posted dose is counted from positions on a Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series course, entries dated before 2017-10-20 are records of the earlier live zoster vaccine: where Kestrel reported its dose of the course to the state registry every such entry is set aside, and where Kestrel gave a dose it has not yet reported all but one of them are set aside until the pharmacist confirms the product; otherwise no entry is set aside for its date.

Z.2 The date that divides the records is 20 October 2017 (2017-10-20). A dose entry dated before that day is a live zoster vaccine record; a dose entry dated on or after it is not set aside for its date.

Z.3 The clause concerns Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series courses only. On a course of any other Immunization Services vaccination, no entry is set aside for its date.

## Condition and effect

| Course | Kestrel's dose of the course | Live zoster vaccine records set aside |
|---|---|---|
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | Kestrel reported its dose to the state registry | Every one |
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | Kestrel gave a dose and no Kestrel registry report is on the course | All but one, until the pharmacist confirms the product (none where there is only one) |
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | Kestrel gave no dose of the course | None |
| Any other vaccination | — | None |

## Hypothetical examples

- A Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series course holds two entries dated in 2016 and one Kestrel dose reported to the state registry: both 2016 entries are set aside.
- The same course, but Kestrel's dose is not yet reported: one of the two 2016 entries is set aside and one stands, until the pharmacist confirms the product.
- The same course with a single 2016 entry and Kestrel's dose not yet reported: all but one of one entry is none, so nothing is set aside.
- A Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series course whose entries are all dated after 2017-10-20: nothing is set aside for its date.
